summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the motor_018 contract. The governance-stage wrapper delegates directly to the runtime adapter, emits governed chart assets with taxonomy metadata and bilingual copy, adapts curation copy by mode, and preserves case-stamped chart context for downstream isolation checks.

findings: The implementation accepts the documented report-identity, facility-prior, congruence, measurement and finance-dependency inputs, with the wrapper enforcing mapping-shaped input before runtime delegation.

Executable coverage confirms structural and exploratory chart generation, distinct congruence copy by mode, distinct blocked/exploratory legacy chart copy, image payload presence and stable chart-taxonomy mapping.
Chart assets remain subordinated to upstream evidence posture through curation modes, section hints, epistemic markers and support-state fields.
The motor stays within boundary: it does not emit uncategorized known charts or unstamped chart assets detached from the current case.
The wrapper returns the expected top-level surfaces: chart_assets, total_charts, chart_errors and case_namespace_register.
The read-only governance-wrapper smoke check over the structural congruence fixture produced total_charts=9, chart_errors=0 and preserved same-case stamping for the first emitted chart asset.
The same smoke confirmed the first emitted asset as chart_context_routing_status with chart_category=context_routing and title=Supporting Routing Context.

test_results.coverage_assessment: Executable conformance evidence covered structural/exploratory chart generation, chart taxonomy behavior, mode-specific copy changes, image payload generation and chart-context stamping. This is sufficient for conformance review because it exercises both the governed visual surface and the taxonomy/isolation constraints that matter downstream.
test_results.notes: Ran pytest -q on runtime-orchestrator/tests/test_congruence_chart_generation.py and runtime-orchestrator/tests/test_chart_taxonomy.py with 6 passing tests and environment warnings from urllib3/LibreSSL and matplotlib font parsing. Also executed a read-only smoke invocation through artifacts/implementation/codebase/engine.py using the structural congruence fixture and confirmed the wrapper returns governed chart assets with case stamping intact.
